collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child who knows every word of the same bedtime story asks for a new one tonight.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every night (subject) tells (friend) the same bedtime story, about a little turtle who was looking for the perfect rock. (friend) knows every word. Tonight (friend) sits up and says, "Can I have a NEW story?"

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) starts a story about a bird who wanted to learn to swim. It goes well for a while. Then, somehow, the bird meets a little turtle, and the turtle is looking for the perfect rock, and before (subject) knows it (subject.he/she) is telling the old story again. (friend) is asleep before (subject.he/she) notices. (subject) decides that counts as a new story.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) tells a long story about a crab who became the leader of the whole ocean and then had a nap. It has no ending, because (friend) falls asleep in the middle of it. (subject) sits in the dark for a while, wondering how the crab's nap went.
